verdict.rationale: The README offers several install paths that avoid compiling: pre-built binaries on the GitHub releases page, Docker images, Winget, and the llama.app install instructions. A community user confirms running the official release binaries on macOS, though only after clearing the quarantine attribute with xattr. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs for each package channel (the Winget and llama.app entries are bare mentions), and a smoother macOS binary experience without manual quarantine removal.
